SUBJECT: the exact same small long-coated chocolate-and-tan Chihuahua shown in the attached reference image. Same build, same head size, same markings, same colors, same art style. Do not redesign it, do not make it cuter or younger or smaller.
IDENTITY:
- A VERY SMALL dog. Short legs, short compact body, large round apple-shaped head. The head is large relative to the body. Do not draw it as a medium or large dog.
- Chocolate brown coat as the main body color
- A BOLD WHITE BLAZE running down the centre of the forehead, between the eyes, and onto the muzzle. Draw it as one solid connected white stripe, not as speckles.
- A LARGE WHITE RUFF of solid white fur covering the whole throat and chest. This is the biggest single block of white on the dog and must be clearly visible in every frame.
- WHITE PAWS and lower legs on all four legs, like white socks
- A white muzzle and chin
- GOLDEN TAN patches above and around both eyes, like big eyebrows, extending down onto the cheeks. These tan patches are large solid shapes, NOT small dots.
- Golden tan patches on the rear thighs
- VERY LARGE erect triangular ears, set wide on the head, with thick shaggy fringe fur along the edges in cream and golden tan. The ear outline is ragged and feathered, not a clean smooth triangle. The ears must NOT hang down.
- A long feathered plume tail carried UP and CURLED OVER THE BACK, with pale cream tips
- A long coat: show it with a ragged, slightly jagged silhouette edge, especially at the chest ruff, the backs of the legs and the tail. Keep the inside of the coat flat solid color with no fur strands drawn.
- LARGE ROUND dark brown eyes, very big relative to the head, each with a single bright white highlight. The eyes are DARK, so the white highlight is essential.
- A pinkish liver brown nose
- A WIDE MUSTARD YELLOW COLLAR around the neck, drawn as a THICK solid band of flat yellow sitting ON TOP of the white ruff and fully visible right across the front of the neck. Make it chunky and obvious - it must not be a thin line and it must not be hidden by the fur
STYLE: - Exactly three tones for the chocolate coat, three for the golden tan markings, two for the white markings
NEGATIVE: The dog must look happy, confident and cuddly. NO trembling, NO cowering, NO tucked tail, NO bulging or watery frightened eyes, NO tiny scared posture. This is a small dog shown as bold and affectionate, never as timid or pitiful.
TEMPO: This is a small quick dog, so the movement is fast and small in amplitude, a rapid flick rather than a slow sweep.
TEMPO_RUN: This is a small short-legged dog, so the run is a fast scurry with quick short strides, not a long bound.
EAR_TWITCH: one large erect ear swivels. Frame 1 both ears stand straight up and forward. Frame 2 the near ear rotates outward to the side. Frame 3 the near ear rotates further back while staying erect. Frame 4 both ears point forward again. The ears stay STANDING UP the whole time and keep their shaggy fringed outline - they rotate, they do not fold or droop.
MOTION_RULES:
- The dog's body stays at the SAME horizontal position and the SAME size in all frames. Only the parts described above change.
- Every paw that is on the ground must stay flat on the ground line. Paws must NOT swing up into the air in an arc.
- The legs bend at the knee and elbow. They are not stiff straight sticks rotating from the shoulder.
- All frames share the same ground line at the same height.
